I fixed the cleartext error by allowing plain HTTP only for the emulator host `10.0.2.2`. I did not build or run the app, since I can only read and edit files here.

The cause is that Android blocks cleartext (non-HTTPS) traffic by default, and the app had no network security config to permit it.

Changes:
- **New file `app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml`**: a `domain-config` with `cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"` for the domain `10.0.2.2`.
- **`app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`**: added `android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"` to the `<application>` element.

I scoped it to `10.0.2.2` rather than setting `usesCleartextTraffic="true"` globally, so other hosts still require HTTPS. If your release builds should not allow even this, keep the config in a debug-only resource set (e.g. `src/debug/res/xml/`).
